Under the Equality Act of 2010 we have a responsibility to safeguard against discrimination on grounds of a protected characteristic. Above all, we want to support all applicants in this process, and make it as inclusive as possible. All reasonable adjustment requests are considered and supplied where possible.

The attached guide on this page sets out what reasonable adjustments are available to support you through the vetting process. We want to work with you to remove any barriers for you so please let us know your needs.
